title: I totally disagree — мнения и споры

items.example: Nearly half of us waste our time at work on Fridays.
They look up funny news articles on the internet.
We watch silly cat videos when we need a break.
We plan our next holiday instead of working.
Many people think the internet can be bad for relationships.
They argue with their partners who spend too much time online.
Get off the internet and get on with life.
